Here are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that specifically offer vegetarian meals and spa services: | Retreat | Location | Highlights | |---------|----------|------------| | **The Retreat at the Hudson** | Rhinebeck, NY (Hudson Valley) | • 7‑day yoga & wellness program
• All‑vegetarian, farm‑to‑table meals
• On‑site spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy
• Meditation, breathwork, and nature walks | | **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Catskill) | • 5‑day yoga & mindfulness retreat
• Vegetarian & vegan menu featuring local produce
• Spa treatments (hot stone, aromatherapy, body scrubs)
• Outdoor yoga on the property’s gardens | | **Yoga House Westchester** | Westchester County | • 3‑day intensive yoga workshops
• Vegetarian lunch & dinner options
• Spa services including massages and sauna
• Private yoga rooms and serene garden setting | | **The Yoga Retreat at the Hudson** | Rhinebeck, NY | • 6‑day yoga & wellness program
• Vegetarian meals prepared by a chef
• Spa amenities: massages, hot tubs, and relaxation rooms
• Scenic views of the Hudson River | **How to book** 1. Visit each retreat’s official website (search the name + “New York” to find the correct site). 2. Check the program dates that fit your schedule. 3. Confirm that the retreat includes the vegetarian meal plan and spa services you’re looking for. 4. Reserve your spot—most retreats require a deposit and have cancellation policies. If you’d like more details on any of these options or help with booking, just let me know!
